approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a clean side-by-side comparison layout in one landscape 16:9 image using the two supplied photos. Place the FIRST supplied image (old kitchen with brown cabinets) on the LEFT and the SECOND supplied image (renovated kitchen with white cabinets) on the RIGHT. Preserve each original photograph exactly: do not redraw, retouch, restyle, change objects, alter colors, or modify either kitchen. Only uniformly resize each full photo to fit neatly within two equal-width panels, preserving aspect ratio without cropping or stretching. Use a simple neutral white background and padding as necessary. Place the exact label 'Before' centered above the left photo and 'After' centered above the right photo in clean legible dark sans-serif type. Keep margins balanced, photos aligned, and a narrow neat gutter between the panels. This is only a photo collage/layout operation, not a kitchen redesign.
